Car Fires Reported Across India, Families Escape Blaze

Multiple incidents of cars catching fire while in motion have been reported across India. In Panipat, a family narrowly escaped a severe fire that engulfed their car as they were traveling to bathe in the Yamuna River; the fire reportedly involved a water tanker. In Barabanki, a driver died after his CNG car caught fire, with reports indicating the central locking system prevented his escape, leading to him burning alive.
